Mark Zuckerberg, COB and CEO of Facebook Inc is the insider, our editorial team want to reveal transactions for. Mr. Mark submitted an electronic form with the Security Exchange Commission disclosing a transaction for 457,000 shares of the corporation, the one he is an insider in. At the time of the dealing, the average stock market price per share of Facebook Inc was $183.2, making the dealing worth $83,735,306 U.S. Dollars. He also unloaded 3,594,082 shares worth $637,652,430 USD in the last month. This is a stocks unloading that is not going to remain hidden as Mark already has in hand 18.77 million shares accounting for 10%+ of the Company’s market cap

Facebook, Inc. provides various products to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, and other surfaces worldwide. The company has market cap of $534.03 billion. The Company’s solutions include Facebook Website and mobile application that enables people to connect, share, discover, and communicate each other on mobile devices and personal computers; Instagram, a mobile application that enables people to take photos or videos, customize them with filter effects, and share them with friends and followers in a photo feed or send them directly to friends; Messenger, a messaging application to communicate with people and businesses across platforms and devices; and WhatsApp Messenger, a mobile messaging application. It has a 30.54 P/E ratio. The firm also offers Oculus virtual reality technology and content platform, which allow people to enter an immersive and interactive environment to play games, consume content, and connect with others.

Safe Bulkers, Inc. provides marine drybulk transportation services worldwide. The company has market cap of $316.79 million. It is involved in the acquisition, ownership, and operation of drybulk vessels for transporting bulk cargoes, primarily coal, grain, and iron ore. It currently has negative earnings. As of February 17, 2017, the firm had a fleet of 38 drybulk vessels with an aggregate carrying capacity of 3,421,800 deadweight tons.
